verdict: FAIL_SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY. The one-shot governance, exact-50-ps Tcl binding, K8-only axis, exact one-license/one-DC call sites, attempt-before-license order, same-UID exclusion, lock ownership, signal-safe quarantine and future M1945/M1946 identity parser are present. However, the runner does not independently parse the numeric total-cell area from reports/area_posthold.rpt or compare it with the frozen 137363.9139348 um2 ceiling. It only checks that the file is nonempty and trusts the Tcl-side mapped_leaf_area gate. This violates the explicit M1940 successor requirement to independently parse report_area and leaves the claimed runner-level fair +5 percent area gate incomplete. The pre-attempt marker also repeats M1938's authorized-versus-observed census ambiguity. No release or EDA attempt is authorized.

findings.title: Runner does not independently parse or gate the post-hold area report
findings.evidence: Runner line 127 only includes reports/area_posthold.rpt in the nonempty regular-file loop. No command extracts the unique 'Total cell area:' value and no runner-side numeric comparison against 137363.9139348 um2 exists. The only runner mentions of area_ceiling are the future release metadata assertion and the nonnumeric receipt field. M1940 mandatory successor requirement 3 explicitly requires independently parsing report_area as well as timing and DRC reports.
findings.impact: A raw M1943 PASS would demonstrate that the Tcl-side mapped_leaf_area assertion returned, but not that the independently emitted report_area value was checked by the one-shot runner. The release chain therefore cannot claim a fully closed, independently gated +5 percent fair-area contract.
findings.required_fix: In a fresh additive runner identity, extract exactly one numeric 'Total cell area:' row from reports/area_posthold.rpt, reject missing/duplicate/nonfinite/nonpositive values, compare it with 137363.9139348 um2 using a fixed trusted parser, and record the observed area plus baseline ratio in the raw receipt. Keep the existing Tcl-side mapped_leaf_area gate as the first guard.

findings.title: Attempt marker labels authorized maxima as observed execution counts
findings.evidence: ATTEMPT_CONSUMED.txt is atomically published before lmstat, yet states license_queries=1 and dc_shell_runs=1. A failure or signal after attempt publication but before either call would preserve those values even though the observed counts were zero. This repeats the census ambiguity documented by M1938-P2-01.
findings.impact: The one-shot budget is still exactly one license call site and one DC call site, so this does not create retry or overuse risk; it only weakens forensic accuracy on early failure.
findings.required_fix: Label pre-attempt fields license_queries_authorized_maximum=1 and dc_shell_runs_authorized_maximum=1. Track observed call launches in the work directory and include authorized and observed fields separately in both success and failure receipts.

minimum_next_action: Author a fresh additive K8-only exact-50-ps runner that independently parses and gates the unique post-hold Total cell area and separates authorized from observed tool census; then obtain a different-author runner hammer before any release or EDA action.
